The billionaire tax would backfire on California

By Sam Writer, Opinion columnist

California voters will decide whether to impose a one-time tax of five percent on the net worth of residents with more than one billion dollars in assets, with the money going to health care.

Supporters say the billionaire tax would raise tens of billions of dollars. Critics say the wealthy will simply move to another state before the tax takes effect, taking their future income taxes with them.

The state already depends heavily on a small number of very high earners, and a wealth tax would make that dependence worse rather than better, this column argues.
